CuratorMapping.description: Maps one distinct created_by / updated_by value from the association records to the curator's identity. Email is required for current, active curators (it matches their ABC login); full name alone is acceptable for former curators. Ids with no mapping are stored verbatim as the user id in the ABC.

email.description: The curator's current work email, as used for their ABC login. Required for current, active curators.

full_name.description: The curator's display name, "First Last". Required when email is absent (former curators).

user_id.description: The exact created_by / updated_by value being mapped (case-insensitive match).

CuratorMapping.title: CuratorMapping

EntityReferenceAssociation.description: One curated association between a reference and an entity (or a topic-only literature annotation when the entity slots are empty). Provenance is the curation of the association itself in the MOD database, not the addition of the paper.

created_by.description: The MOD's internal user id of the curator who curated the association (not who added the paper). Every distinct value should have a CuratorMapping. Strongly encouraged; when absent (e.g. dumps predating this column), the ABC default user (default_user) is stamped instead.

date_created.description: When the association was curated in the MOD database, in the timezone declared by the submission. Strongly encouraged; when absent (e.g. dumps predating this column), the load date is stamped instead.

date_updated.description: When the association was last modified, in the declared timezone; defaults to date_created when absent.

display_section.description: MOD-specific literature-topic / display section the association appears under on the MOD's reference pages (e.g. SGD's Primary Literature, Additional Literature, Reviews, Omics); mapped by prior agreement with the ABC team to an ABC display_tag ATP curie -- NOT to the ABC tag's topic slot. Named "topic" in SGD's dump (the alias); called display_section here to avoid colliding with the ABC's topic column, which holds an ATP topic curie. The alias is documentation only: a MOD converting its TSV to JSON must rename the topic column to display_section -- the generated (closed) JSON Schema accepts only the display_section key.

entity_id.description: The MOD's stable identifier for the entity (e.g. SGDID S000002284); must be resolvable through the Alliance persistent store. Empty for a topic-only annotation.

entity_name.description: Human-readable entity name (e.g. ACT1, act1-1); used for report sanity checks, not for resolution.

entity_type.description: The kind of entity the reference is associated with, one of the 13 types in entity_type_enum: gene, allele, transgenic_allele, classical_allele, species, strain, genotype, fish, transgenic_construct, sequence_targeting_reagent, antibody, complex, pathway. Canonical values are the snake_case enum names; submitted files may write them with spaces (each value's title), which the loader normalizes.

reference_id.description: The MOD's identifier for the paper (e.g. SGDID S000039113) or a PMID curie (PMID:12345678); resolved through the ABC reference cross-references.

updated_by.description: The MOD's internal user id of the last curator to modify the association; defaults to created_by when absent.

EntityReferenceAssociation.title: EntityReferenceAssociation

EntityReferenceAssociationIngest.description: Root container for one MOD submission: the association records plus the curator mappings resolving every distinct created_by / updated_by value they use.

curator_mappings.description: One mapping per distinct created_by / updated_by value appearing in the association records.

entity_reference_associations.description: The association records of this submission.

mod_abbreviation.description: Alliance abbreviation of the submitting MOD (e.g. SGD, ZFIN, WB, MGI, RGD, FB).

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the date_created / date_updated values (e.g. America/Los_Angeles), or UTC when the timestamps are exported already converted. The ABC converts to UTC at load time. Note for JSON submissions: datetime values must carry an explicit offset (JSON Schema date-time, e.g. 2024-03-15T10:22:31-07:00), which should agree with this declared timezone; offset-less TSV timestamps are interpreted in this timezone by the loader.

EntityReferenceAssociationIngest.title: EntityReferenceAssociationIngest

EntityTypeEnum.description: Entity types accepted in entity-reference association submissions, matching the entity types available in the ABC curation interface. Not every MOD uses every type (complex and pathway are mainly SGD; fish, genotype, transgenic construct, and sequence targeting reagent are mainly ZFIN). Extensible by agreement with the ABC team; each maps to the ATP term given as its meaning.
